Maharaja Bir Bikram MBB College 1st Merit List 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Maharaja Bir Bikram College, Agartala (MMB) has released the 1st Merit List for admissions in BNMU University UG 2026-27 on the official website of MMB. The online application process for Maharaja Bir Bikram MBB College UG Admissions Online Form 2026 were accepted from 29 May 2026, to 09 June 2026.
